WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.acct_ref,
    -- TEI components
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', 'None')::numeric / 100, 0) AS vpn_ratio,
    COALESCE((s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric, 0) AS proxy_hits,
    COALESCE((s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric, 0) AS country_count,
    -- PCI components
    COALESCE(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score', '0')::numeric AS credibility_score,
    COALESCE(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score', '0')::numeric AS reputation_score,
    COALESCE(a."ProfileScore", 0) AS profile_completeness,
    -- SRS components
    COALESCE(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value', '0')::numeric AS risk_value,
    COALESCE(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score', '0')::numeric AS trust_value,
    COALESCE(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score', '0')::numeric AS impact_value
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN security_sessions s ON a.acct_ref = s.acct_gate
  JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON a.acct_ref = r.acct_risk
)
SELECT 
  acct_ref,
  vpn_ratio, proxy_hits, country_count,
  credibility_score, reputation_score, profile_completeness,
  risk_value, trust_value, impact_value,
  -- TEI
  ROUND(CAST(0.4 * vpn_ratio + 0.3 * (proxy_hits / 10.0) + 0.3 * (country_count / 20.0) AS numeric), 4) AS TEI,
  -- PCI
  ROUND(CAST(0.3 * credibility_score + 0.3 * reputation_score + 0.4 * profile_completeness AS numeric), 4) AS PCI,
  -- SRS
  ROUND(CAST(0.4 * risk_value + 0.3 * (1 - trust_value) + 0.3 * impact_value AS numeric), 4) AS SRS
FROM base
LIMIT 5;
